title: ql_apply's eval gate reads passed and n but not noted, so an auto-applied change that puts a note on an eval good passes it
goal: ql_apply's gate refuses a change whose rag.run_eval result has noted above rag.NOTED_BASELINE, as rag.py eval does (ST-6s4ff6fa added noted to run_eval, found by the SP-4o3plg4l review)

run: import sys,inspect;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_apply;s=inspect.getsource(ql_apply);sys.exit(0 if 'noted' in s or 'NOTED_BASELINE' in s else 1)

repro_reason: the gate's refusal needs an auto-applied change that raises noted on a fixture store; the repro reads whether ql_apply reads noted at all

run: import pathlib,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import rag,ql_apply;g=ql_apply.Gate();ev=lambda n:{'n':1,'passed':1,'noted':n,'rows':[{'id':'EV-x','ok':True,'failed':[],'chars':10}]};rag.run_eval=lambda *a,**k:ev(rag.NOTED_BASELINE);base=g.measure();p=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())/'e.csv';p.write_text(','.join(ql_apply.CSV_HEADERS['eval'])+'\n');rag.run_eval=lambda *a,**k:ev(rag.NOTED_BASELINE+1);ok,why=ql_apply.try_fix({},['EV-y','question','a.md','good',''],{'eval':p},g,base);print('gate passed a change above NOTED_BASELINE:',ok,why);sys.exit(1 if ok else 0)

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 2 of 15, "Pack notes, router cost and query-log apply guards read what they should"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Premise run 2026-10-13 on the base: both the source-read repro and the planted-gate check (try_fix with run_eval noted = NOTED_BASELINE+1 returns ok=True, no problems) fail (precheck). Follows BG-5fentnzk (ql_apply.py, test_redact.py).
